# Credibility quality fixtures (spec 055)

Static note + spec snippets for credibility resolver / metric tests. Per spec 026,
tests copy these into `tmp_path` — nothing here is mutated during runs.

See `notes/` for per-case frontmatter (`credibility`, `coi`, `source_urls`) and
`spec-snippet.yaml` for `data_sources[]` / `note_types` declarations used by
`build_credibility_context`.
